name: library-release
title: Library release
description: Use this skill when preparing to release a supported @lewishowles library package.
when: When preparing a release for a supported @lewishowles library
do-not-use-when: Updating a project to consume an already-published library release

Choosing or inspecting component-library options without release work
Designing human-friendly-cli command behaviour without release work
